title: Overview

firstRun.title: How an expense works
firstRun.lead: Spent your own money for the guild, or paid with a guild card? This is where you get it back.
firstRun.step1Body: Upload the receipt and fill in what the purchase was for and which cost center it belongs to.
firstRun.step2Title: The result unit owner approves it
firstRun.step2Body: Whoever is responsible for the cost center approves the expense. You can see where it is, and who it is waiting on, the whole way through.
firstRun.step3Body: The expense becomes a voucher and is exported to Fortnox.
firstRun.step4Body: Paid out to your account. Add your clearing and account number under My profile, or the expense will stall there.
